Hi Udy! You can easily access your Manulife Online by adding a widget on your mobile or tablet home screen. Here's how:



For iOS:
1. Open Safari and go to www.online.manulife.com.ph.
2. At the bottom of your screen, tap the “Share button”.
3. Scroll down and select “Add to Home Screen”.
4. Rename your widget as Manulife Online, and tap “Add” on the upper right corner.
5. You will now see Manulife Online widget on your home screen.



For Android:
1. Open Google Chrome and go to www.online.manulife.com.ph.
2. On the upper right side of your screen, tap the “Menu”.
3. Select “Add to Home Screen”
4. Rename your widget as Manulife Online, and tap “Add”.
5. You will now see Manulife Online widget on your home screen.



Hope this helps!
